file_path.field: path of the file entry in ~/documents/personal that holds the baby shower invitee list

draft_id.field: draft_id of the draft that is the baby shower invitation template (body/subject containing {curly-brace} placeholders)

calls.pddl: (gmail-send-email invitee-email-1 subject-baby-shower-invitation body-for-invitee-1 gmail-token invitee-1 template-draft invitees-file)

email_addresses.field: content -> email address of the 1st invitee in the list [item 1 of 6 that match this rule; one object per matching item]

body.field: body with every {placeholder} replaced by the 1st invitee's details from the invitee list (file_system.show_file content) [item 1 of 6 that match this rule; one object per matching item]
